review_description: I recently had an issue with my solar panel inverter, and I’m extremely impressed with how quickly and professionally the company handled it. The inverter was out of order, and after reporting the problem, they promptly assessed the situation and replaced it without any hassle.The entire process was smooth, efficient, and stress-free. The team was courteous, knowledgeable, and genuinely cared about resolving the issue. It’s rare to see this level of customer service nowadays, and I couldn’t be happier with the outcome.Thank you for standing by your product and delivering such excellent after-sales support. Highly recommended!

When first receiving quotes from multiple companies they fell into 3 categories - expensive local, cheap online with bad reviews and cheap online with good reviews (not many). I was initially concerned about the low cost - but a cheaper system has a quicker payback period/ROI. What was important was the length of time the company has been around, and the reviews given. Solar World have been around for 12 Years and had many recent positive reviews.Ryan from Solar World was extremely helpful when discussing options, turnaround time for responses was beyond expectations (super quick and after hours). Installation went great, system looks tidy and is performing well. I got Seraphim panels (13.2kw) and Growatt inverter (10kw) - all running as expected and without any issues (2 months on).I previously had a 4kw system, so the job included removal and disposal of existing as well. The new system upgrade was definitely worth it and can easily run multiple power-hungry air-con, whitegoods and appliances.I would highly recommend Solar World.

This review is true and an actual reflection of my experience with Solar World...I would like to sincerely thank you and your team for installing our solar panels at Europa Street, Box Hill on 15th / 16th April 2020.From start to finish, the job was done well The installers worked all day in the hot weather until night time to get most of the work done and returned the next day to do touch up etc. They are good hard working people!Also, I would like to thank the manager personally for all of your assistance from the first time we got in touch with you. Your customer service is amazing and your pricing / packages are fantastic.On another note, the system has consistently been generating HUGE KW hours. Even on a cloudy day, we generate very good numbers!So what happened from 15th April to 13th July? A $232.29 credit is what happened!!! So AGL paid us into our bank account and reset the quarter to $0. Guess what? We are now in a $31.43 CREDIT and we have 69 days to go until the quarter is finished.Even in Winter as the cooler weather gets a tad warmer, the system has been producing some BIG numbers that we can monitor via WiFi with our SOLIS inverter:- 3/8 - 40.2kWh, 2/8 - 42.6kWh, 1/8 - 44.8kWh. With those kinds of numbers, AGL should be VERY afraid of our house haha.Please feel free to use this email as a testimony of my gratitude towards Solar World. We are thankful that you have helped us save money and live bill-free.Wishing you and the team at Solar World all the success now and into the future.
